newsitem.title: FINLAND: POHJOLA SEES FINNS BUYING MORE INSURANCE.
newsitem.headline: POHJOLA SEES FINNS BUYING MORE INSURANCE.

text.p: An increase in purchasing power next year, which follows tax cuts, will lead Finns to buy more insurance, insurance group Pohjola Oy President Iiro Viinanen said on Wednesday.
"Citizens are likely to start improving their security in the form of insurance, in pension insurance saving or in non-life insurance," Viinanen said according to a copy of his prepared speech.
He also saw good prospects for growth in Finnish exports and said "this is promising for the value of Pohjola's investment porfolio."
Viinanen spoke at a Pohjola-sponsored economic seminar.
Finance Minister Sauli Niinisto and UPM-Kymmene Oy CEO Juha Niemela were among other speakers at the seminar.
